Name: Gas burner
Description: A single middle-sized gas burner on natural gas, a domino hob (GasHobSpec.SingleBurner, GasHobSynth, docs/GAS_HOB.md). The interact key standing at it lights it, ticking until it catches, or turns it off. Place it on the worktop with its back (+Z) to the wall. Not a recording and not a loop.
